115.h: 20 - Umm Salamah, Mother of the Believers, Hind bint Abī Umayyah al-Makhzūmiyyah * (ع)
115.t:
The Lady, the veiled, the pure: Hind bint Abī Umayyah ibn al-Mughīrah ibn ʿAbd Allāh ⟦2:201⟧ ibn ʿUmar ibn Makhzūm ibn Yaqaẓah ibn Murrah al-Makhzūmiyyah, cousin of Khālid ibn al-Walīd, the Sword of Allah, and cousin of Abū Jahl ibn Hishām.
Among the first women Emigrants.
Before the Prophet ﷺ she was married to his foster brother, Abū Salamah ibn ʿAbd al-Asad al-Makhzūmī, the righteous man.
The Prophet ﷺ consummated the marriage with her in the year 4 of the Hijrah.
She was among the most beautiful of women and the noblest of them in lineage, and she was the last of the Mothers of the Believers to die.
She lived long enough for the killing of al-Ḥusayn the martyr to reach her; she was stunned by it and fainted, and she grieved greatly over him; she did not live long after him, and passed on to Allah.
She had children who were Companions (الصحابي): ʿUmar, Salamah and Zaynab.
She has a number of hadiths.
Narrating from her: سعيد بن المسيب، وشقيق بن سلمة، والأسود بن يزيد، والشعبي، وأبو صالح السمان (1) ، ومجاهد، ونافع بن جبير بن مطعم، ونافع مولاها، ونافع مولى ابن عمر، وعطاء بن أبي رباح، وشهر بن حوشب، وابن أبي مليكة، وخلق كثير.
She lived about ninety years.
And her father: he is Zād al-Rākib (2), one of the generous men - it is said his name was Ḥudhayfah -.
Whoever called her Ramlah erred; that one is Umm Ḥabībah. ⟦2:202⟧
She was counted among the jurists (الفقيه) of the female Companions (الصحابي).
الواقدي: حدثنا عمر بن عثمان، عن عبد الملك بن عبيد، عن سعيد بن يربوع، عن عمر بن أبي سلمة، قال:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent my father to Abū Qaṭan in Muḥarram in the year 4, and he was away for twenty-nine nights, then returned in Ṣafar with the wound he had received on the day of Uḥud reopened; he died of it when eight nights had passed of Jumādā al-Ākhirah, my mother's waiting period ended in Shawwāl, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ married her.
Until he said: And she died in the year 59 in Dhū al-Qaʿdah (1).
ابن سعد: أخبرنا أحمد بن إسحاق الحضرمي، حدثنا عبد الواحد بن زياد، حدثنا عاصم الأحول، عن زياد بن أبي مريم:
Umm Salamah said to Abū Salamah: It has reached me that any woman whose husband dies, and he is of the people of Paradise, and she does not remarry, Allah will join the two of them in Paradise. So come (2), let me make a pact with you that you will not marry after me, and I will not marry after you.
He said: Will you obey me?
She said: Yes.
He said: When I die, marry. O Allah, grant Umm Salamah after me a man better than me, who will neither grieve her (3) nor harm her.
When he died, I said: Who is better than Abū Salamah?
It was not long before the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came and stood at the door and mentioned the proposal through her nephew, or her son.
She said: Shall I turn away the Messenger of Allah, or come before him with my dependants?
Then he came the next day and proposed (4).
عفان: حدثنا حماد، حدثنا ثابت، حدثني ابن عمر بن أبي سلمة، ⟦2:203⟧ عن أبيه:
That when Umm Salamah's waiting period ended, Abū Bakr proposed to her and she turned him down, then ʿUmar, and she turned him down.
Then the Messenger of Allah sent to her, and she said: Welcome. Tell the Messenger of Allah that I am a jealous woman, that I have young children (1), and that none of my guardians is present.
He sent back to her: (As for your saying that you have young children: Allah will suffice you for your little ones; as for your saying that you are jealous: I will ask Allah to take away your jealousy; and as for the guardians: there is none of them but will be pleased with me).
She said: O ʿUmar, rise and give me in marriage to the Messenger of Allah.
And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: (Truly I shall not give you less than what I gave to so-and-so ... ), the hadith (2).
عبد الله بن نمير: حدثنا أبو حيان التيمي، عن حبيب بن أبي ثابت، قال:
Umm Salamah said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to me and spoke to me, with a screen between us, and proposed to me.
I said: What do you want from me? I say this only out of my lack of desire for you; I am ⟦2:204⟧ a woman whose age has advanced, I am the mother of orphans, I am very jealous, and you, O Messenger of Allah, have many wives.
He said: (As for jealousy, Allah will take it away; as for age, I am older than you; and as for your orphans, they are in the care of Allah and His Messenger).
So I gave my consent, and he married me (1).
أبو نعيم: حدثنا عبد الواحد بن أيمن، حدثني أبو بكر بن عبد الرحمن بن الحارث:
That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ proposed to Umm Salamah, and she said:
I have three qualities: I am old, I have a nursing child, and I am very jealous ... , the hadith (2).
And from al-Muṭṭalib ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Ḥanṭab, who said:
The widow of the Arabs entered upon the master of the Muslims at the beginning of the night as a bride, and rose at the end of the night grinding - meaning Umm Salamah -.
مالك: عن عبد الله بن أبي بكر، عن عبد الملك بن أبي بكر بن عبد الرحمن، عن أبيه، قال:
When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ consummated his marriage with Umm Salamah, he said: (You are in no way disgraced before your family. If you wish, I will stay seven nights with you, and then seven with them - meaning his wives - or if you wish, three, and then I rotate?).
She said: Three (3).
روح بن عبادة: حدثنا ابن جريج، أخبرني حبيب بن أبي ثابت، أن عبد الحميد بن عبد الله، والقاسم بن محمد حدثاه، أنهما سمعا أبا بكر ⟦2:205⟧ بن عبد الرحمن يخبر، أن أم سلمة أخبرته:
That when she arrived in Medina she told them that she was the daughter of Abū Umayyah, and they did not believe her, until some of them set out for the Hajj, and they said: Will you write to your family?
So she wrote with them, they returned, and they believed her, and her standing among them increased.
She said: When Zaynab was born, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to me and proposed to me, and I said: The like of me is not married!
He said: So he married her, and he used to come to her and say: (Where is Zunāb?).
Until ʿAmmār came and snatched her away (1), and said: This one keeps the Messenger of Allah away.
She used to nurse her, and the Prophet ﷺ came and said: (Where is Zunāb?)
It was said: ʿAmmār took her.
He said: (I will come to you tonight).
She said: So I set down my hand-mill (2), took out some grains of barley that were in my jar, and took out some fat and cooked a porridge for him; then he spent the night, and then the morning came.
He said: (You have honor with your family. If you wish, I will stay seven nights with you? But if I stay seven with you, I will stay seven with my wives (3)).
Muṣʿab al-Zubayrī said: She was the first woman in a howdah to enter Medina as an emigrant; Abū Salamah witnessed Badr; and she bore him: ʿUmar, Salamah, Zaynab and Durrah.
أبو أسامة: عن الأعمش، عن شقيق، عن أم سلمة، قالت:
When Abū Salamah died, I came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: What should I say?
He said: (Say: O Allah, ⟦2:206⟧ forgive us and him, and grant me after him a good outcome).
I said it, and Allah gave me Muḥammad (1) ﷺ in exchange.
Muslim narrated in (his Ṣaḥīḥ (2)): that ʿAbd Allāh ibn Ṣafwān entered upon Umm Salamah during the caliphate (الخلافة) of Yazīd.
وروى: إسماعيل بن نشيط، عن شهر، I came to Umm Salamah to console her over al-Ḥusayn (3).
Among the virtue of the Mothers of the Believers is His saying, the Exalted: “O wives of the Prophet, you are not like anyone among women, if you fear Allah ... ,” up to His saying: “and establish prayer, give zakah, and obey Allah and His Messenger. Allah only wishes to remove from you impurity, O People of the House, and to purify you thoroughly. And remember what is recited in your houses of the verses of Allah and wisdom” [Qurʾān, al-Aḥzāb: 32 - 34]. ⟦2:207⟧
These are noble verses concerning the wives of our Prophet ﷺ.
قال زيد بن الحباب: حدثنا حسين بن واقد، عن يزيد النحوي، عن عكرمة، عن ابن عباس: “Allah only wishes to remove from you impurity, O People of the House,” he said: it was revealed regarding the wives of the Prophet ﷺ.
Then ʿIkrimah said: Whoever wishes, I will invoke a mutual curse with him that it was revealed specifically regarding the wives of the Prophet ﷺ (1).
إسحاق السلولي: حدثنا عيسى بن عبد الرحمن السلمي، عن أبي إسحاق، عن صلة، عن حذيفة:
That he said to his wife: If it pleases you to be my wife in Paradise, do not marry after me, for a woman in Paradise belongs to the last of her husbands in this world; for that reason it was forbidden to the wives of the Prophet ﷺ to marry after him, because they are his wives in Paradise (2).
He narrated: عطاء بن السائب، عن محارب بن دثار:
That Umm Salamah left instructions that Saʿīd ibn Zayd, one of the Ten Promised Paradise (العشرة المبشرة) (3), should pray over her.
This is disconnected (منقطع).
Saʿīd had died some years before her; perhaps she gave the instruction at one time, then recovered, and he preceded her.
And it is narrated that Abū Hurayrah prayed over her, but this is not established, and he died before her. ⟦2:208⟧
She was buried in al-Baqīʿ.
قال محمد بن سعد: أخبرنا محمد بن عمر، أخبرنا ابن أبي الزناد، عن هشام بن عروة، عن أبيه، عن عائشة، قالت:
When the Prophet ﷺ married Umm Salamah, I grieved intensely because of what they told us of her beauty; I contrived until I saw her, and I saw her - by Allah - many times what had been described to me in beauty; I mentioned that to Ḥafṣah - the two of them were of one accord -.
She said: No, by Allah, this is only jealousy; she is not as you say, though she is indeed beautiful. Later I saw her, and she was as Ḥafṣah had said, but I was jealous (1).
مسلم الزنجي: عن موسى بن عقبة، عن أمه، عن أم كلثوم، قالت:
When the Prophet ﷺ married Umm Salamah, he said to her: (I have sent as a gift to the Negus several ounces of musk and a robe, and I think he has died, and I do not see the gift but being returned; if it is returned, it is yours).
She said: It was as he said; he gave each of his wives an ounce, and gave the rest to Umm Salamah, along with the robe (2).
القعنبي: حدثنا عبد الله بن جعفر الزهري، عن هشام بن عروة، عن أبيه:
That the Messenger of Allah ordered Umm Salamah to pray the dawn prayer in Mecca on the Day of Sacrifice, and it was her day, as he liked her to meet him there (3). ⟦2:209⟧
الواقدي: عن ابن جريج، عن نافع، قال: Abū Hurayrah prayed over Umm Salamah (1).
I say: al-Wāqidī is not to be relied upon - and Allah knows best - especially as he has been contradicted.
And in Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim: that ʿAbd Allāh ibn Ṣafwān entered upon Umm Salamah during the caliphate (الخلافة) of Yazīd (2).
Some of them dated her death to the year 59, and they erred too; the apparent view is that she died in the year 61 (may Allah be pleased with her).
The Prophet ﷺ had married her when her waiting period ended, in Shawwāl, in the year 4.
Her total of transmitted hadiths reaches three hundred and seventy-eight hadiths (3).
Al-Bukhārī and Muslim agreed on thirteen of hers.
Al-Bukhārī alone had three, and Muslim thirteen. ⟦2:210⟧
